name: treasure-deposit
description: M4 Phase 3 scenario (epic #163; scoring): a treasure taken and put in the trophy case. Fresh boot by <FLOAD "77loadall.mud"> and <SAVE-IT> on the fixed session clock (fixed_epoch 250776000, zone UTC, microseconds 0); unmodified pinned sources, START seeds RANDOM from DSKDATE, no RANDOM override and no seed search. The house-cellar path (lamp, rug, trap door, lamp on, `down`; the trap door crashes shut), `look` in the cellar, then `south` twice to the Gallery, `take painting` (OFVAL 4 scored by SCORE-OBJ), `south` to the Studio and `up` the chimney (CHIMNEY-FUNCTION: at most two objects, the lamp among them) to the kitchen, `west` to the living room, `open case`, `put painting in case` (the living room's action sets ASCORE to RAW-SCORE plus the OTVALs in the case: 39 + 7 = 46), `look`, `score`. The `look` in the cellar is part of the route: without it (thief-robbery) the thief takes the painting in the Gallery under this clock and seed; the route was chosen, not the randomness. Each command was confirmed by the pinned native reference; see docs/evidence/M4/TREASURE-DEPOSIT-REFERENCE.md. Input ends after `score` (D3 end-of-input applies).
